title: a full run leaves the DSH home byte-identical
titleZh: 完整跑一遍后,DSH home 逐字节不变
why: The isolation claim of the whole plugin is 'read-only by default'. This case builds a disposable DSH home that looks real (settings.yaml, two profiles, a .credentials.yaml placeholder that is never read), hashes every file, runs the collector against it, and hashes everything again. Any created, deleted or rewritten byte fails the case - including a cache file or a rewritten settings.yaml.
inject: a temp DSH_HOME with settings.yaml, two profiles and an untouched .credentials.yaml; the collector is pointed at it with -DshHome
expectSummary: every file hash unchanged, no file created or deleted, CREDENTIAL_DISCIPLINE pass, exit 1
